planets.name: TOI-815 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-815 with a 11.2-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-815 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around TOI-815. Its orbit and size follow Psaridi et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
